interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] I am Officer Phuc. I am asking about the man found beyond this alley.

response_choices: Binh came here for coffee three mornings running.
Binh said his receipt and Hanh's book did not match.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] We have not confirmed his identity. I need times, names, things you actually saw.

response_choices: His neighbors have not seen him since.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] Thank you. May I buy [b]one bottle of water[/b] while I am here?
[color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] I will come back tomorrow. If someone asks you to destroy a receipt or change a date, keep it.
